guarantees.claim: data_err_o is high if any bit of the 2-bit data_err is high, otherwise low.

assumptions.claim: DataMaxWidth must be 32 and DataIntgWidth must be 7 so that data_intg_i forms a 39-bit input matching the fixed-size prim_secded_inv_39_32_dec instance.
assumptions.risk: Width mismatch would connect data_intg_i incorrectly, causing X propagation or incorrect decoding.

uncertain_points.claim: Corrected data (data_o) and syndrome (syndrome_o) from the decoder are unconnected; correctable errors still assert data_err_o but no corrected data is available, possibly discarding useful fault‑tolerance or diagnostic information.
uncertain_points.risk: Loss of error correction capability may cause unnecessary bus errors or prevent logging of error patterns.

formal_sketch.consequent: Corrected data (data_o) and syndrome (syndrome_o) from the decoder are unconnected; correctable errors still assert data_err_o but no corrected data is available, possibly discarding useful fault‑tolerance or diagnostic information

uncertain_points.claim: The 2-bit err_o from prim_secded_inv_39_32_dec is OR-reduced; it is not specified whether correctable and uncorrectable errors should be distinguished on data_err_o or if any non‑zero syndrome should always set the output.
uncertain_points.risk: If the protocol expects separate handling of correctable vs uncorrectable errors, the OR-reduction hides that distinction and may lead to incorrect fault handling.

formal_sketch.consequent: The 2-bit err_o from prim_secded_inv_39_32_dec is OR-reduced; it is not specified whether correctable and uncorrectable errors should be distinguished on data_err_o or if any non‑zero syndrome should always set the output
